title: Viva Glint: Rewrite with Copilot for survey comments
summary: Hold: the briefing treats guest access and the applicability of Glint's data-processing protections as undocumented, although Microsoft states those rules for Copilot in Viva Glint generally. The roadmap facts, off-by-default setting and core rewriting behaviour are supported.

claims.where: front matter: products; title
claims.claim: The feature belongs to Microsoft Viva and concerns Viva Glint survey commenting.
claims.quote: "title": "Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot assisted commenting in Glint survey taking"; "products": ["Microsoft Viva"]

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Rewrite with Copilot provides alternative versions of comments survey takers have already written, rather than writing comments for them.
claims.quote: No. Rewrite with Copilot only provides rewritten versions of comments that the survey taker originally wrote.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The feature is intended to improve comment clarity.
claims.quote: Improve clarity and readability of survey comments

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The feature can adjust the tone of a comment.
claims.quote: Adjust tone (for example, more professional or more casual)

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The feature aims to reduce distinctive writing styles that might make comments recognisable.
claims.quote: Reduce distinctive writing styles that might make comments recognizable while aiming to preserve the writer's original intent

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft describes preservation of the writer's original intent as an aim, not a guarantee.
claims.quote: Reduce distinctive writing styles that might make comments recognizable while aiming to preserve the writer's original intent

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Using Rewrite with Copilot is optional and controlled by the survey taker.
claims.quote: The rewritten suggestions are optional, and the survey taker is fully in control of if and how they use the Rewrite with Copilot feature.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The survey taker chooses whether to accept a rewritten suggestion.
claims.quote: Users decide whether to use Copilot in Glint and whether to accept the suggested rewritten comments.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: A dedicated Microsoft 365 admin center setting titled Copilot in Viva Glint Survey Taking controls the feature.
claims.quote: A dedicated setting titled Copilot in Viva Glint Survey Taking in the Microsoft 365 admin center controls the feature.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; controls[0].note; rationales
claims.claim: The feature is off by default and survey takers cannot use it until an administrator enables it, matching admin-opt-in.
claims.quote: The setting is off by default. ... To use Copilot-assisted commenting, survey takers must meet the following requirements: ... Have Copilot enabled by their administrator (organization-wide or scoped access).

claims.where: controls[0].governs; summary; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can enable the Survey Taking setting organisation-wide.
claims.quote: Enable Copilot in Viva Glint Survey Taking for the organization or for specific users or groups

claims.where: controls[0].governs; summary; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can enable the Survey Taking setting for specific users.
claims.quote: Enable Copilot in Viva Glint Survey Taking for the organization or for specific users or groups

claims.where: controls[0].governs; summary; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can enable the Survey Taking setting for specific groups.
claims.quote: Enable Copilot in Viva Glint Survey Taking for the organization or for specific users or groups

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The Survey Taking setting can be managed independently from the existing Copilot in Viva Glint setting.
claims.quote: Yes. A new setting controls the feature, and you can manage it independently from the existing Copilot in Viva Glint setting in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and controls[1].api; controls[1].note; What's changing; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: There is no individual-survey or individual-programme enable/disable control for Rewrite with Copilot.
claims.quote: You can't enable or disable this feature for individual surveys or programs.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Survey takers must authenticate to Glint using Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: Be authenticated into Glint by using their Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The feature is unavailable when surveys are accessed through personalised links.
claims.quote: The feature is not available when: ... Surveys are accessed through personalized links.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The feature is unavailable when surveys are accessed using attribute-based authentication.
claims.quote: The feature is not available when: ... Surveys are accessed by using attribute-based authentication.

claims.where: Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: The feature page lists Copilot being disabled for the user or organisation as a condition that makes the feature unavailable.
claims.quote: The feature is not available when: ... Copilot is disabled for the user or organization.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Copilot-assisted commenting supports all languages in Viva Glint's survey experience, including more than 60 languages.
claims.quote: Copilot-assisted commenting supports all languages available in Viva Glint's survey experience, including more than 60 languages.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: The roadmap frames reduced identifiable writing patterns and editing effort as ways to encourage participation, longer responses and more candid comments.
claims.quote: By increasing perceived security through reducing identifiable writing patterns and minimizing the effort required to refine feedback, this experience can encourage greater participation, longer responses, and more candid comments

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Glint reports and exports do not identify which comments were rewritten with Copilot.
claims.quote: No. Survey reports and exports don't show whether Copilot was used to rewrite a survey taker's original comment.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The original comment text is temporarily used to generate Copilot rewrite suggestions.
claims.quote: This feature temporarily uses the original text to generate rewritten suggestions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The original text used for rewriting is not retained after the survey taker submits the rewritten response.
claims.quote: The text isn't retained after the user submits the rewritten survey response.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Unaccepted rewrite suggestions are not saved as survey data.
claims.quote: Unaccepted suggestions aren't saved as part of the survey data. Only the final submitted comments are saved as part of survey results.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Copilot-assisted commenting interactions are not used to train generative AI foundation models.
claims.quote: These Copilot-assisted interactions aren't used to train any generative AI foundation models.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The Copilot in Viva Glint privacy page describes use of Azure OpenAI Service.
claims.quote: Copilot in Viva Glint uses Microsoft-hosted large language models provided through Azure OpenAI Service.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The Copilot in Viva Glint privacy page describes processing within the Microsoft 365 service boundary.
claims.quote: When using Copilot in Viva Glint features (such as comment summarization in Copilot in Viva Glint), raw survey responses, prompts, and respondent user attributes are processed entirely within the Microsoft 365 service boundary.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The Copilot in Viva Glint privacy page describes regional data-residency commitments.
claims.quote: When Copilot in Viva Glint calls Microsoft-hosted large language models to process raw survey responses, prompts, and respondent user attributes, processing is aligned with Viva Glint's data residency commitments for your tenant's region.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The Copilot in Viva Glint privacy page does not explicitly name Rewrite with Copilot.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Rewrite with Copilot data processing residency; read copilot-privacy in full and searched its returned text for Rewrite and Survey Taking; neither feature name appears.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions: processing, residency and EU Data Boundary
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described processing or established the applicability of its Copilot in Viva Glint processing and residency statements to this feature.
claims.quote: When using Copilot in Viva Glint features (such as comment summarization in Copilot in Viva Glint), raw survey responses, prompts, and respondent user attributes are processed entirely within the Microsoft 365 service boundary.
claims.fix: Replace the second Data exposure bullet with: 'Microsoft states that Copilot in Viva Glint features process raw survey responses, prompts and respondent user attributes within the Microsoft 365 service boundary, use Microsoft-hosted models through Azure OpenAI Service, and align LLM processing with Viva Glint data-residency commitments for the tenant region.' Keep the existing citation https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/copilot-privacy. Remove the Open question asking whether these product-wide statements apply to Rewrite with Copilot; the page states their reach for Copilot in Viva Glint features, not only its summarisation example.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Microsoft states that Copilot in Viva Glint is unavailable to Microsoft Entra cross-tenant guest users.
claims.quote: Copilot in Viva Glint isn't available to Microsoft Entra cross-tenant guest users. Copilot features are hidden for these users regardless of your VFAM configuration, because the underlying Microsoft Copilot large language model (LLM) services don't currently support cross-tenant guest users.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The access page lists Copilot Highlights, the chat panel and comment summarisation as examples hidden from cross-tenant guests.
claims.quote: Copilot features are hidden for these users, including Copilot Highlights, the Copilot button and chat panel, and the Copilot summarize option in the comments panel.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Guests; Open questions: guests
claims.claim: How the cross-tenant guest restriction applies to guest survey takers using this feature is not stated.
claims.quote: Cross-tenant guest users are evaluated separately from VFAM precedence. Copilot in Viva Glint is unavailable to these users regardless of the organization-wide setting or any custom policy.
claims.fix: Replace the guest caveat in Risk assessment and Scope with: 'Copilot in Viva Glint is unavailable to Microsoft Entra cross-tenant guest users regardless of the organisation-wide setting or any custom policy.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/copilot/mac-copilot-access. Remove the guest-availability part of the final Open question. The page's examples introduced by 'including' do not limit its product-wide guest restriction.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Copilot access-policy changes can take up to 24 hours to reach users, and Microsoft advises avoiding further changes to the same policy during that period.
claims.quote: Changes to Copilot access policies in the Microsoft 365 admin center can take up to 24 hours to take effect for users. ... Avoid making additional changes to the same policy within 24 hours of an initial change, as successive changes may not apply as expected.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Users may receive a potentially offensive input error because Rewrite with Copilot applies Azure AI Content Safety harm categories.
claims.quote: Why do some users see an error message about potentially offensive input? Rewrite with Copilot follows the harm categories used by Azure AI Content Safety to identify and handle potentially objectionable content.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The content-safety checks can produce false positives.
claims.quote: In some instances, there might be false positives.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Survey takers can report false positives using the feedback option within Rewrite with Copilot.
claims.quote: If a survey taker encounters a false positive, they can use the feedback option within the Rewrite with Copilot feature to let the team know.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The included licensing model names Viva Glint, Microsoft Viva Suite or Microsoft Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback as the product-level entitlement for Copilot in Viva Glint.
claims.quote: A license for Viva Glint, Microsoft Viva Suite, or Microsoft Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback is required to access Copilot in Viva Glint.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A Microsoft Copilot licence is not required to access Copilot in Viva Glint.
claims.quote: A license for Microsoft Copilot is not required to access Copilot in Viva Glint.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions: survey-taker licensing
claims.claim: No separate licence requirement specific to Rewrite with Copilot survey takers is published, and its feature page names no licence of its own.
claims.quote: Searched: Rewrite with Copilot Glint license price meter; opened rewrite-comments-copilot-viva-glint, mac-copilot-access, copilot-privacy and glint-order-teams. Product-level licensing is documented; no separate Rewrite survey-taker entitlement is stated.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No feature-specific meter, credit rate or price for Rewrite with Copilot is published on the feature and privacy pages or found by targeted search.
claims.quote: Searched: Rewrite with Copilot Glint license price meter; opened rewrite-comments-copilot-viva-glint, copilot-privacy, mac-copilot-access and glint-order-teams. No feature-specific meter, credit rate or price was stated.
